verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows an AI assistant inside AnyDesk. The CLI and REST API cover scripted automation, and llms.txt is machine-readable documentation; both are adjacent building blocks, not an assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
